'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good day, mercenary. You arrived just in time. Some of my partners would like us to test the weapons before purchasing them. They require a demonstration. Take 7.62x51 assault rifles and designated marksman rifles and head to Reserve. There has been some suspicious activity reported there recently... Let us combine business with pleasure.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 15 targets with headshots with [[7.62x51]] assault rifles or DMRs on [[Reserve]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 1,900 Dollars
** 1,995 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 2,185 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|I have already been informed of how you performed. The order from my partners has been confirmed.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill any 15 enemies with headshots using a [[7.62x51mm NATO]] assault rifle or designated marksman rifle. You can use any of the following:
* [[DS Arms SA58 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* [[Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* [[FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* [[FN SCAR-H X-17 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* [[HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle]]
* [[Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* [[Kel-Tec RFB 7.62x51 rifle]]
* [[Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle]]
* [[Remington R11 RSASS 7.62x51 marksman rifle]]
* [[Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle]]
